details:
some people like to block other players so they can become invisible, annoy group admins & break some games.

an example of this would be on "Blackout!" because the game has nothing to visualize any of the players when someone blocks another they just become entirely invisible making the world less fun to play.

there should be a tab in the social menu that'd tell you if you're in a instance with someone who has blocked you so they could be kicked & also on the website so if a player that's blocked you is being malicious they can be reported instead of just playing the guessing game on who's blocked you and started doing malicious things.

something that'd also be great would be a toggle for a world maker to visualize blocked players like: if a player blocks you then you'd be able to see where they are & even select them but if you're the one who blocked someone else you wouldn't be able to see where they are so they cant just use the visualizer to continue harassing
title: Users who've blocked you tab
